title: Power one sequential tests exist for weakly compact $\mathscr P$ against $\mathscr P^c$
abstract: arXiv:2604.03218v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study power-one sequential testing for an i.i.d. law on a Polish sample space. Given a nonempty composite null class $\Pcal\subseteq\mathcal M_1(\X)$, we ask when there exists a level-$\alpha$ stopping rule that rejects almost surely under every alternative in a prescribed class $\Qcal\subseteq\Pcal^c$. Our main sufficient condition is local weak lower semicontinuity and positivity of the information projection functional \( \Phi_\Pcal(Q):=\inf_{P\in\Pcal}\KL(Q\|P). \) In particular, if $\Pcal$ is weakly compact, then for every $\alpha\in(0,1)$ there is a single level-$\alpha$ sequential test with power one against the entire complement $\Pcal^c$. The proof combines Csisz\'ar's nonasymptotic Sanov bound for weakly closed convex empirical-measure sets with a Lindel\"of countable-subcover argument. translated_title: 弱紧集$\mathscr P$对$\mathscr P^c$的功率一序贯检验存在性
translated_abstract: 摘要：我们研究在波兰样本空间上独立同分布定律的功率一序贯检验。给定一个非空复合零假设类$\Pcal\subseteq\mathcal M_1(\X)$，我们询问何时存在一个水平-$\alpha$的停止规则，使得在规定的备择类$\Qcal\subseteq\Pcal^c$中的每个备择假设下几乎必然拒绝。我们的主要充分条件是信息投影泛函\( \Phi_\Pcal(Q):=\inf_{P\in\Pcal}\KL(Q\|P) \)的局部弱下半连续性和正性。特别地，如果$\Pcal$是弱紧的，那么对于每个$\alpha\in(0,1)$，存在一个单一的水平-$\alpha$序贯检验，其对整个补集$\Pcal^c$具有功率一。证明结合了Csiszár关于弱闭凸经验测度集的非渐近Sanov界与Lindelöf可数子覆盖论证。我们还通过给出有限样本不连续的示例，表明弱下半连续性充分但非必要。
tldr: 该论文证明了当零假设类是弱紧时，存在对所有备择假设具有功率一的单一水平-$\alpha$序贯检验，并给出了基于信息投影泛函的充分条件。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that when the null class is weakly compact, a single level-$\alpha$ sequential test with power one against all alternatives exists, providing a sufficient condition based on the information projection functional.
